sections.title: Vector Robot AI
content: Con su cámara HD y sensores avanzados, el Vector Robot AI mapea en tiempo real, reconoce rostros y esquiva obstáculos. Este robot ya no necesita un control remoto, ya que su tecnología autónoma lo hace reaccionar de forma independiente. Ahora, con la integración de ChatGPT, Vector no solo responde preguntas complejas, sino que también participa en conversaciones significativas en múltiples idiomas, desde inglés hasta alemán. Imagina un compañero inteligente que interactúa con su entorno y te acompaña en tu día a día.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 200 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: AI-Powered & Fully Autonomous: Vector navigates, recognizes faces, and reacts to his surroundings with lifelike independence — no remote control required.

Now Connected to ChatGPT (subscription required): Experience a new level of conversation! With ChatGPT integration, Vector can answer complex questions, hold meaningful chats, and offer more natural and intelligent responses.

Multilingual Support: Vector can now understand and speak in multiple languages, making him the perfect smart companion for global households and language learners. Vector can chat in English, Spanish, French, German, and more! Say “Hey Vector.”
Smart Camera & Sensors: Built with an HD camera and advanced sensors for real-time mapping, facial recognition, and obstacle detection.
Expressive Personality: Watch Vector come to life with animated eyes, emotions, and playful reactions that evolve as you interact with him.

sections.title: Scanmarker Air Pen
content: Este lápiz traduce mientras escanea, perfecto para estudiantes y viajeros.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 149 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: SAVE TIME & BOOST PRODUCTIVITY: Create summaries faster than ever! Simply open the web app, connect your pen scanner, and slide it across a line of printed text — watch it appear instantly on your screen! This versatile scanner pen is perfect for busy students and professionals. Note: Connection to a computer or mobile device is required to operate the scanner.

POWERFUL LANGUAGE TRANSLATOR DEVICE: Enjoy accurate and rapid multilingual OCR scanning. This translation pen supports over 140 languages, seamlessly integrating into our web app or applications like Microsoft Word. Whether you need a pen translator for travel or academic use, the Scanmarker Air is your go-to tool.

TEXT TO SPEECH FOR ENHANCED LEARNING: The Scanmarker app reads the text aloud in real-time while scanning! Perfect for memorization and reading comprehension, this reader pen also serves as an effective assistive tool for those with dyslexia or reading difficulties. Ideal as a reading pen for dyslexia or any learning challenge.

ULTRA PORTABLE & CONVENIENT: Scan and edit on the go! The Scanmarker Air is a lightweight, wireless translator pen, designed for ultimate portability. Easily connect to computers, smartphones, or tablets via Bluetooth 4.0 or higher, making it ideal for scanning, translating, and editing anywhere.

FREE SUPPORT & 1-YEAR WARRANTY: Questions or concerns? We offer free software updates and 24/7 technical support for the lifetime of your product. With no hidden fees, we also provide a full one-year warranty, ensuring peace of mind with every purchase.

sections.title: Ruler Digital Ink
content: ¿Cansado de buscar la escala perfecta en tus mediciones? El Ruler Digital Ink ofrece 93 escalas integradas y permite crear ilimitadas escalas personalizadas, ideal para arquitectos y diseñadores. Además, con su función de divisor de espacio, puedes segmentar cualquier distancia sin complicadas cuentas. Y no solo mide: su aplicación gratuita vía Bluetooth transfiere datos a tu smartphone para editar y compartir en formatos como CAD o PDF. Este dispositivo transforma la manera en que gestionas tus proyectos.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 110 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 93 BUILT-IN SCALES: NeoRuler provides 93 built-in scales for maximum versatility. Multiple units; decimal feet, feet-inches, decimal inches, yards, millimeters, meters, kilometers

CUSTOMIZE INFINITE SCALES: NeoRuler allows you to define unlimited scales when missing or out-of-plan scales. Perfect match for work of architect, interior designer, civil engineers, real estate, and any DIY projects.
SPACE DIVIDER: Equally divide space quickly to any length without any calculation, and divides a certain distance into 2-12 sections with LED light indicator on NeoRuler.

FREE APP via BLUETOOTH: Transfer measured data to MEAZOR APP and continue further editing & drawing to track data. Export to CAD files dxf. pdf. jpg. to share at ease. Create and save unlimited scale lists on MEAZOR APP and upload them on NeoRuler anytime.
MODULAR DESIGN:5 sets of modules to assist with reading, drafting, collecting, and even transforming into a scale caliper(Need to Purchase Additional Accessories）
